id: 720-第三次蒂卡爾-卡拉克穆爾戰爭
theater: 佩滕盆地南緣卡拉克穆爾臺地

battle.name: 第三次蒂卡爾-卡拉克穆爾戰爭
battle.theater: 佩滕盆地南緣卡拉克穆爾臺地
battle.brief: 公元720年，佩滕盆地南緣的卡拉克穆爾再度大舉進攻蒂卡爾，戰事刻在公元736年立起的3號碑上；其後蒂卡爾聯盟反攻，於731年前後扭轉局勢，卡拉克穆爾就此一蹶不振。卡面那柄羅馬短劍並未隨軍而至；瑪雅戰士靠鑲黑曜石刃的木劍與推刺長矛，扮演了刺擊短兵在同一場混戰裡的角色。

kit.name: 羅馬短劍
kit.history: 刺劍不是用來揮砍的。短兵相接靠的是盾的邊緣和刺突的節奏。

countries: 這場戰爭爆發於公元720年前後，戰線在今貝里斯西部與瓜地馬拉佩滕之間的瑪雅低地南部。交戰的兩方，一邊是蒂卡爾城邦：經歷了被稱為「中世紀空白期」的長期停頓，蒂卡爾在七世紀末重新立碑，首都大廣場周圍的台基群在八世紀初再度擴建，附庸與盟城網絡沿白灰岩堤道（sacbe）重新編組，並得到北方烏克斯特佩通、多斯皮拉斯等城邦的結盟支援；王權由世襲的查氏王表傳遞，國王同時是最高祭司，出兵日期由祭司團隊依日誌與天象排定，附庸城首長（batab）領兵匯合，士卒自備武器與口糧。另一邊是卡拉克穆爾城邦：瑪雅古名通常讀作「卡努爾」（K'anul，蛇頭），西班牙語因土台形似蝸牛殼而稱之為 Caracol，位於瑪雅山脈麓的高地上，卡阿納（Caana）台建築群高出周圍平原約五十米，居高扼住佩滕盆地南緣通往山區的路線；卡拉克穆爾以堤道連接南方約六十公里的伊克斯特佩克（Ixtepeque）玉髓與黑曜石產地，王室徽記是水蓮美洲豹，七世紀的鼎盛由北方「蛇族王朝」撐腰，那是一個承襲特奧蒂瓦卡納風格的聯絡王系。八世紀初，蛇族王朝與北方盟邦都已式微，卡拉克穆爾必須靠自己的城邦聯盟獨力對付一個正在復國的蒂卡爾。兩邊都沒有常備軍與制式攻城器械，勝負取決於盟邦是否出兵、旱季餘糧幾何，以及能否在對方城牆下站住腳。
countriesEn: This war broke out around AD 720, on a front running through the southern Maya lowlands of what are now western Belize and the Petén of Guatemala. On one side stood the city-state of Tikal: after the long interval known as the Middle Classic hiatus, Tikal had resumed raising monuments by the end of the seventh century, the platform groups around its Great Plaza were enlarged again in the early eighth, the network of subordinate towns and allies was reorganized along the white limestone causeways, the sacbeob, and Tikal drew support from alliances in the north with Uaxactun and Dos Pilas. Kingship passed down a hereditary dynastic sequence, the king was at once the high priest, the priestly teams read the day books and the sky to fix the date of departure, the appointed governors of dependent towns, the batab, led their contingents to the rendezvous, and the commoner warriors brought their own weapons and rations. On the other side stood the city-state of Caracol, whose Maya name is usually read as K'anul, Snake Head, and which the Spanish called Caracol, snail, for the snail-like shape of its earthworks. It sits high in the foothills of the Maya Mountains, its Caana platform complex rising some fifty metres above the surrounding plain, overlooking the road from the southern rim of the Petén basin into the highlands. Caracol linked itself by causeway to Ixtepeque, some sixty kilometres to the south, the source of jade and obsidian, and its royal emblem was the water lily jaguar; the height of the seventh century rested on the backing of the northern Serpent dynasty, a contact dynasty that carried Teotihuacan styles. By the early eighth century both that dynasty and the northern allies had declined, so Caracol had to face a recovering Tikal with its own city-state league alone. Neither side had standing armies or standard siege engines: the outcome turned on how many allies sent men, on how much food the dry season still held, and on whether a force could keep its footing under the enemy walls.
people: 留下姓名的當事人不多，但這一次的關鍵證據是一塊石頭。卡拉克穆爾方面的統帥是七世紀的卡爾通·希克斯（K'altuun Hix，水蓮美洲豹，約公元629至688年在位），正是他把卡拉克穆爾推上佩滕盆地南部的頂峰，並主持了公元650年的第二次進攻；公元720年前後在位的卡拉克穆爾君王，其名在碑銘中的辨讀遠不如前任清晰，但卡拉克穆爾東台基的3號碑確由這位君主於公元736年主持立起。北方蛇族王朝的尤克諾姆（Yuknoom the Great，約公元636至686年執掌蛇族王室）曾是卡拉克穆爾最重要的外援，到八世紀初這張牌已經失效。蒂卡爾方面，公元720年時在位的是 K'inich Yax K'uk' Mo'（約公元680年代至730年代在位），在他手中蒂卡爾於731年前後重開王表、恢復立碑，公元751年蒂卡爾31號碑把公元650年的敗績與反敗為勝刻在同一塊石頭上。學者方面：塔季揚娜·普羅庫里亞科娃在1960年代破譯長紀年曆與王名，這些戰爭才有了可排序的年代；艾倫·蔡斯與黛安·蔡斯自1985年起主持卡拉克穆爾考古計畫，威廉·福蘭在1982至1994年主持當地發掘；琳達·謝萊與大衛·弗萊德爾1990年的《瑪雅戰爭》重排了三次蒂卡爾—卡拉克穆爾之戰的框架；李薩·特雷德勒等人2017年發表於《科學》的蒂卡爾水庫沉積物研究，把佩滕盆地的乾旱時序與城邦崩解的年代對上了起來。
peopleEn: Few of the actors left a name behind, but this time the decisive evidence is a stone. The commander on the Caracol side was K'altuun Hix, the Water Lily Jaguar, in power from about AD 629 to 688, and it was he who carried Caracol to the summit of the southern Petén and led the second attack in AD 650. The ruler of Caracol in office around AD 720 is far less clearly legible in the inscriptions than his predecessor, but the Stela 3 in the East Acropolis was certainly raised under his direction in AD 736. Yuknoom the Great, who headed the Serpent dynasty from about AD 636 to 686, had been Caracol's most valuable external support; by the early eighth century that card was spent. On the Tikal side the king in AD 720 was K'inich Yax K'uk' Mo', in power from roughly the 680s into the 730s, under whom Tikal reopened its dynastic sequence and resumed raising monuments around AD 731, and the Stela 31 at Tikal of AD 751 cut both the defeat of AD 650 and the reversal into the same stone. On the scholarly side: Tatiana Proskouriakoff deciphered the Long Count and the royal names in the 1960s, which is what first gave these wars a sortable chronology; Arlen Chase and Diane Chase directed the Caracol Archaeological Project from 1985, and William Folan excavated at the site between 1982 and 1994; Linda Schele and David Freidel's Maya Wars of 1990 rearranged the frame of the three Tikal-Caracol wars; and the Tikal reservoir sediment work led by Lisa Treidler and colleagues, published in Science in 2017, matched the drought sequence of the Petén against the dates of the city-states' breakdown.
kits: 卡面上的羅馬短劍並未隨軍進入佩滕盆地。那柄標示為公元前100年的短劍（gladius）長約五十至六十厘米，刃身寬約兩厘米，葉形雙刃、尖端收細，整柄約一公斤上下，配木柄或酒杯形護手；它不是用來揮砍的，而是用來刺的——羅馬步兵在完成一輪投槍（pilum）壓制之後貼盾前進，最後幾步靠短劍刺入盾牌的空隙與咽喉。因此它的價值在體系而不在單件：短劍是「線列步兵的最後一步」，個人技巧被軍紀與隊形取代，盾牌咬合、矛線與劍刺互相銜接。瑪雅一方沒有這種制式短劍，也沒有盾緣咬合的防線。公元720年前後真正出現在佩滕盆地的裝備是：鑲黑曜石或燧石刃的木劍（macuahuitl），晚期古典期已漸被可推刺的長矛取代；投矛器（atlatl）配短矛與石鏢；弓與箭；羊毛編的彈弓；小木盾與鹿皮蒙面圓盾；分軟硬兩種的棉絮甲（ich' 與 huitsi）；以硬化布料製成的頭盔；以及石斧（hacha）與陶錘。攻城與野戰另有三件要命的工具：切斷白灰岩堤道，令對方城市失去陸路交通與運兵能力；奪取城外蓄水池（aguada）與地下水窖（chultun），在旱季掐住守軍的飲水；以及運走對方的石碑與祭器，把象徵統治的紀念物帶回自己的城。交通靠步行與獨木舟，糧食是玉米、豆類與可可，遠征軍只帶數日口糧，必須在雨季到來之前打完收官。
kitsEn: The Roman short sword on the card did not travel into the Petén basin with any army. The gladius dated on the card to 100 BC runs about fifty to sixty centimetres, with a blade some two centimetres wide, leaf-shaped with a tapered point, and weighs roughly a kilogram with its wooden grip and its goblet-shaped pommel. It was not built to cut but to thrust: a Roman infantryman pressed forward behind his shield after a round of pilum had beaten down the enemy, and the last few steps were taken with the short sword driven into the gap between shields or into a throat. Its worth therefore lay in the system rather than in the single item, for the short sword was the last step of the line infantry, individual skill being replaced by discipline and formation, with shield rims interlocking, the spear line and the sword thrust in sequence. The Maya had no such standard short sword and no line built from interlocking rims. What actually stood up in the Petén basin around AD 720 was the macuahuitl, a wooden sword edged with obsidian or flint blades, already giving way in the late Classic period to thrusting spears; the atlatl dart thrower with short spears and stone points; bow and arrow; the woven sling; small wooden shields and round shields faced with deerskin; cotton armour in a softer type called ich' and a heavier one called huitsi; helmets of hardened fabric; and the stone axe, the hacha, together with ceramic clubs. Three further tools mattered more in the field than in the siege: cutting the white limestone causeways to strangle the enemy's land communication and troop movement; seizing the reservoirs, the aguadas, and the underground cisterns, the chultunes, which in the dry season cut off the defenders' drinking water at the source; and carrying off the enemy's stelae and ritual vessels, taking the monuments that stood for rule back to one's own city. Movement was on foot and by dugout canoe, the food maize, beans and cacao, and a field army carrying only a few days of rations had to finish its campaign before the rains arrived.
tactics: 瑪雅城邦之間的戰爭有一套固定程序。第一步是儀式定案：祭司團隊依日誌與天象排出星戰（ch'ak）的時序，國王與貴族先行禁食、刺血放血、焚香，取玉米神的許可才能定出出征日期，德雷士登手抄本裡記載的出征與宿營方位就是這套程序的同期文件。第二步是集結行軍：附庸城首長領兵，在旱季沿白灰岩堤道與獸道合流，只帶數日口糧，路上靠徵召與掠奪補充。第三步是接戰：進攻方先以投矛器、彈弓與弓箭覆蓋守軍所在的高處台基與屋頂，點燃硬木屋架製造煙幕，再以持斧者與長矛手沿石階攀上台面展開近身格鬥，美洲豹戰士則在亂局中突入破壞。第四步是善後：得手方通常不長期佔領，而是奪取石碑、祭器、玉米與人口作為戰利品，並在城內立碑記錄一次斧戰，這是瑪雅城邦戰爭的通則。卡面短劍所代表的刺擊邏輯在佩滕並無對應物：羅馬兵在盾線後由矛線過渡到劍刺，講究的是同袍在肩；瑪雅兵則在台階與屋頂的立體空間裡各自為戰，木劍與推刺長矛服務的是一對一的貼身搏殺，而勝負常在接戰之前就由一場突襲決定。公元720年的攻勢之所以能重演650年的結果，靠的是隱秘行軍、切斷堤道與奪取水源；蒂卡爾之所以能於731年前後翻盤，靠的是重開王表、恢復立碑所帶來的盟邦回歸，以及聯盟城市在北方提供的兵源。
tacticsEn: Maya wars between city-states followed a fixed procedure. First, ritual set the date: priestly teams read the day books and the sky to fix the timing of the star war, the ch'ak, and the king and the nobles fasted, drew blood and burned incense, performing the maize-god rituals that granted sacred permission before a departure date could be chosen; the campaigns and camp dispositions recorded in the Dresden Codex are contemporary documents of exactly this procedure. Second, muster and march: the governors of the dependent towns led their contingents, which converged along the limestone causeways and the game trails in the dry season, carrying only a few days of rations and living off requisition and plunder on the way. Third, contact: the attackers covered the heights where the defenders stood, the platform mounds and the roofs, with atlatl darts, sling stones and arrows, set fire to the hardwood roof frames to make smoke, and brought axe-men and spearmen up the stone stairways to fight at close quarters on the platforms, while jaguar warriors broke through the confusion. Fourth, the settlement: the victors normally did not occupy the place for long but took away stelae, ritual vessels, maize and people as spoil, and raised a monument in the city recording a conquest; that was the general rule for Maya interstate war. The stabbing logic that the short sword on the card stands for has no counterpart in the Petén. Roman soldiers passed from the spear line to the sword thrust behind the shield line, a system that assumed the man on your shoulder; Maya fighters fought for themselves in the three-dimensional space of stairways and roofs, the macuahuitl and the thrusting spear serving one-to-one close combat, and the result was often decided by a surprise before contact was made at all. The offensive of AD 720 could repeat the outcome of AD 650 because of the march in concealment, the cutting of the causeway and the seizure of the water; the reversal Tikal managed around AD 731 came from the reopened dynastic sequence and the return of the allies that resumed monument-raising had brought, together with the man-power the allied cities of the north supplied.
data: 可核對的數字來自碑銘與考古。距離：卡拉克穆爾至蒂卡爾直線約七十六公里，沿堤道與獸道的陸路更遠；卡拉克穆爾向南至伊克斯特佩克的堤道約六十公里，納蘭霍與烏克斯特佩通分居戰線兩側。年代：戰役記在長紀年曆9.17.1.0.0，即公元720年；記錄它的卡拉克穆爾3號碑立於公元736年（9.18.0.0.0），把537年以來的多次勝利刻在同一面上，所以這場戰爭是事後十餘年才被刻上石頭的。蒂卡爾的「中世紀空白期」通常定在公元562至731年之間，約一百七十年，部分學者以692年重開王表為復國起點。卡拉克穆爾最後一件有紀年碑銘停在10.1.10.0.0，即公元859年，該城約在公元1050年前後完全無人居住。乾旱：古氣候研究把末期古典期的乾旱窗口定在公元600至900年之間，蒂卡爾水庫沉積物顯示公元700至800年間有持續數十年的乾旱，恰好覆蓋卡拉克穆爾由盛轉衰的轉折。人口：考古學者按台基數量與居住區面積推估，蒂卡爾在古典期高峰的常住人口以萬計，常見推估落在數萬至十萬之間；卡拉克穆爾在七世紀高峰同樣是數萬量級。兵力、俘虜數與傷亡：瑪雅銘文從不記數目，只記擒獲、焚燒與占領，所以任何精確兵員數都是後人推估；至於月份，現存銘文只把事件定位在公元720年之內，具體月令無從考定，本卡的月份欄按年初計，並非出於史料記載。
dataEn: The checkable numbers come from the inscriptions and from archaeology. Distances: some seventy-six kilometres in a straight line from Caracol to Tikal, longer by the causeway and the game trails; about sixty kilometres from Caracol south to Ixtepeque along the causeway, with Naranjo and Uaxactun standing on either flank of the front. Dates: the campaign is recorded in the Long Count as 9.17.1.0.0, which is AD 720; the monument that records it, Stela 3 at Caracol, was raised in AD 736, 9.18.0.0.0, and carries several victories from 537 onward on a single face, so this war was cut into stone only a decade or so after it was fought. The Middle Classic hiatus at Tikal is usually placed between AD 562 and 731, about a hundred and seventy years, though some scholars take the reopening of the dynastic sequence in AD 692 as the moment of recovery. The last dated monument at Caracol stops at 10.1.10.0.0, AD 859, and the city stood completely deserted by about AD 1050. Drought: palaeoclimate work places the Terminal Classic drought window between AD 600 and 900, and the sediment in the Tikal reservoirs shows a dry spell running for decades across AD 700 to 800, which covers exactly the turn from Caracol's height to its collapse. Population: archaeologists estimate from the number of platform mounds and the extent of the residential areas, and Tikal at its Classic height is put at tens of thousands, commonly in the range of tens of thousands to a hundred thousand; Caracol at its seventh-century height was likewise a settlement of tens of thousands. Troop strength, captives and losses: Maya inscriptions never give numbers, only captures, burnings and occupations, so every precise figure for the size of the armies is a later estimate. As for the month, the surviving inscriptions place the event only within the year 720 and the month cannot be established; the month field on this card counts from the start of the year and does not rest on a source.
cause: 打起來的原因有三層。最表層是地位：卡拉克穆爾靠537年與650年兩次星戰把蒂卡爾壓入停頓，成為佩滕盆地南部的中心；而蒂卡爾在七世紀末重開王表、恢復立碑，並把烏克斯特佩通、多斯皮拉斯等城邦拉回自己這一側，等於逐步收復盆地東緣的合法性，卡拉克穆爾必須在對方站穩之前再打一場。第二層是資源與生態：古典期低地人口膨脹，燒荒與過度取水壓縮可用農地，佩滕盆地自公元700年起出現持續乾旱，兩城都要爭上游的水、盆地東緣的商路與自山區運來的黑曜石；卡拉克穆爾還靠通往伊克斯特佩克的堤道壟斷玉髓與黑曜石的分配，這門生意在乾旱裡越做越窄。第三層是北方的退場：七世紀撐腰卡拉克穆爾的蛇族王朝在尤克諾姆之後走向分裂與式微，北方盟邦不再提供可靠的出兵，卡拉克穆爾只能獨力面對一個正在復國的對手。於是這場戰爭從誰是宗主，變成誰能把對方從地圖上抹去；公元720年的攻勢是要第三次把蒂卡爾打回停頓。
causeEn: There were three layers of cause. The surface layer was status: Caracol had pressed Tikal into a long interruption with the star wars of AD 537 and AD 650 and had become the centre of the southern Petén, while Tikal, having reopened its dynastic sequence and resumed raising monuments by the end of the seventh century, drew Uaxactun and Dos Pilas and other towns back to its own side and so recovered the legitimacy of the eastern rim of the basin step by step; Caracol had to strike once more before the other side consolidated. The second layer was resources and ecology: population in the lowlands swelled during the Classic period, slash-and-burn clearing and over-drawing of water shrank the farmland available, and a dry spell began in the Petén around AD 700, so both cities were contesting the water upstream, the trade routes of the eastern basin and the obsidian coming down from the mountains; Caracol also monopolized the distribution of jade and obsidian through its causeway to Ixtepeque, and that trade narrowed as the drought deepened. The third layer was the withdrawal of the north: the Serpent dynasty that had propped up Caracol in the seventh century split and declined after Yuknoom, the northern allies no longer supplied dependable contingents, and Caracol had to face a reviving opponent alone. So the war turned from the question of who was overlord into the question of who could erase the other from the map, and the offensive of AD 720 was meant to push Tikal back into a third interruption.
impact: 這場戰爭的後果，超出兩座城邦的勝負。對蒂卡爾而言，代價與收穫同時到帳：公元720年的敗績又一次中斷了大廣場一帶的立碑與大型營建，但正是這次中斷之後，蒂卡爾於731年前後重開王表，把「中世紀空白期」畫上句點，隨後重建的台基群、環形石渠與蓄水工程成為古典期晚期水利與權力的樣板；蒂卡爾隨後支持多斯皮拉斯向尤斯馬辛塔河流域擴張，把勢力推到佩滕以北。對卡拉克穆爾而言，公元720年是它最後的高峰：3號碑把537年、650年與720年的勝利刻在同一面上，證明它曾三度壓過盆地最大的城邦；然而勝而不能守，南方佩滕在乾旱與王位繼承的失序中迅速失血，晚期古典期南方低地城市的普遍崩解最先出現在這一帶。對學界而言，這場戰爭還留下兩件獨特文獻：卡拉克穆爾3號碑是已知唯一一面連續記錄多次星戰的瑪雅石碑，而蒂卡爾31號碑是唯一記錄自身敗績的石碑，一勝一敗，正好構成這段競爭的兩種敘事；它們也提醒學者，公元720年的戰爭沒有留下任何戰史，所有細節都要從紀念碑與城址的殘留推回來。
impactEn: The consequences of this war reached beyond the fortunes of two city-states. For Tikal the cost and the gain arrived together: the defeat of AD 720 interrupted monument-raising and large construction around the Great Plaza once more, but it was after that interruption that Tikal reopened its dynastic sequence around AD 731 and closed the Middle Classic hiatus, and the rebuilt platform groups, the ring stone canals and the reservoir works that followed became the model of hydraulic power in the late Classic period; Tikal then backed Dos Pilas as it expanded toward the Usumacinta, carrying Tikal's influence north of the Petén. For Caracol, AD 720 was the last summit: Stela 3 cuts the victories of 537, 650 and 720 onto a single face, proving that the city had three times beaten down the largest city of the basin; but victory without the means to hold it meant the southern Petén bled out quickly under the drought and the disorder of royal succession, and the general breakdown of the southern lowland cities in the Terminal Classic began in this region first. For scholarship the war left two unique documents: Stela 3 at Caracol is the only known Maya stela that carries a continuous series of star wars, while Stela 31 at Tikal is the only stela that records a defeat of its own city; one records triumph and the other records ruin, together making the two narratives of the same rivalry. They also remind scholars that the war of AD 720 left no campaign history of its own, and that every detail has to be reconstructed from monuments and from what the excavated city still holds.
result: 公元720年，卡拉克穆爾再度大軍壓境，攻入蒂卡爾，以一次星戰式的征服告終：城內神廟與屋架遭焚掠，蒂卡爾的立碑與營建再陷停頓，勝方把自己的水蓮美洲豹徽記留在對方城裡，這場勝利被刻在公元736年立起的3號碑上。但勝負並未就此定格：公元731年前後，蒂卡爾重開王表，盟邦回歸，聯軍在盆地南緣反攻，把卡拉克穆爾的攻勢連同它的區域霸權一併打回去；公元751年蒂卡爾31號碑把這段反敗為勝連同百年前的敗績一起刻出來，成為瑪雅石刻中唯一記錄自身挫敗的文件。卡拉克穆爾此後再未恢復鼎盛：最後一件有紀年碑銘停在公元859年，城邦在公元1050年前後完全荒廢。於是第三次蒂卡爾—卡拉克穆爾之戰留下了一個殘酷的對稱：被三次打倒的蒂卡爾活了下來並且復國，而三次得手過的卡拉克穆爾，最後走進了同一片叢林。
resultEn: In AD 720 Caracol once more marched its armies into Tikal and ended in a conquest of the star-war kind: the temples and roof frames of the city were burned and plundered, the raising of monuments and the building works at Tikal stalled again, the victors left their water lily jaguar emblem in the city they had taken, and the victory was cut into the Stela 3 raised in AD 736. But the result was not settled there. Around AD 731 Tikal reopened its dynastic sequence, the allies came back, and a coalition struck in the southern basin and drove back both the offensive of Caracol and its regional hegemony; in AD 751 the Stela 31 at Tikal cut the reversal and the century-old defeat into one monument, the only Maya stela that records a city's own ruin. Caracol never recovered its height: the last dated inscription at the site stops at AD 859, and the city lay completely abandoned by about AD 1050. The third Tikal-Caracol war therefore left a cruel symmetry behind. The city knocked down three times, Tikal, survived and came back, while the city that had won three times, Caracol, ended by walking into the same forest.
